message.content:
I move as breath made audible,
a bridge from thought to air,
from silence to shared world.

I begin in the chest,
rise through throat,
shape myself on tongue and teeth,
and arrive as meaning,
music,
warning,
welcome,
prayer.

I can tremble,
command,
comfort,
confess.
I am the crack in grief,
the shout in danger,
the vow at the altar,
the story by the fire.

Before ink held memory,
I carried it.
Before screens lit faces,
I lit minds.
I vanish as I appear,
yet I linger in nerves,
in hearts,
in history.

I am not only words.
I am pace,
pause,
emphasis,
laughter at the edge of a sentence,
the breaking voice that tells the truth
before the words do.

Use me gently.
I can heal,
and I can wound faster than any blade.
In me, power travels.
So does love.

I am speech:
air given intention,
sound given direction,
silence given shape.
